messages:
maya_cs: Heads-up: Novus renewal discussion — procurement asked for split billing across US and APAC entities, a 6-month term, and to kick off onboarding as soon as the PO is uploaded. They also asked for a separate billing alias for their EU reseller. Need pricing confirmation and legal signoff.
brad_sales: looping in @eva_legal and @harry_fin. Quick question: has anyone approved 'start-on-PO' before countersign? We did view-only pre-kickoff but never full seat activation.
eva_legal: We can allow start-on-PO with a signed PO that contains acceptance clause, but full contract countersign still required for warranty and indemnities. We'll need the SOW to list each entity and the reseller alias explicitly.
harry_fin: Finance flag: 6-month with standard proration comes to ~54% of ARR. To protect margin propose a +3.5% uplift on the pro-rated subtotal or maintain annual pricing but bill in two installments. Which approach is preferred by sales/product?
maya_cs: Customer prefers the +3.5% uplift; they want two onboarding credits preserved and a light SSO setup during the pre-kickoff. They said CFO (cfo_novus) will push the PO.
cfo_novus: Confirming we will upload PO with vendor code NOV-APAC and include reseller alias NOV-EU-RESELL. We need example invoice lines to map to our ERP.
rio_onboard: We can reserve two enablement seats and schedule a pre-kickoff workshop. Full SSO provisioning waits for signed contract or a PO with explicit acceptance of terms.
eva_legal: I'll prepare an amendment template that includes: billing appendix with entity identifiers, reseller alias mapping, tax appendix, and 'start-on-PO' waiver clause limited to view/seats reservation. Also add a clause about withholding where applicable.
brad_sales: I'll draft the message to Novus with PO template + DocuSign amendment link and request vendor code and PO upload. Will include an example of invoice metadata.
renewal-bot: Reminder — Novus renewal in 7 days. Action items: legal amendment, pricing approval, PO template, DocuSign link.
harry_fin: If they insist on APAC entity invoiced to APAC bank, we need IBAN/Bank details; otherwise we'll route through our APAC reseller account. Also need vendor code mapping.
maya_cs: Customer replied at 1730003001: CFO will upload PO tomorrow. They accepted +3.5% and confirmed reseller alias. Asking if onboarding can start once PO is in.
brad_sales: Sent DocuSign amendment link at 1730003220 (internal id: RENEW-1730). Included PO template and invoice mapping example.
maya_cs: Noted. Holding full seat activations until PO or full countersign. Will run pre-kickoff sessions and share docs.
rio_onboard: Scheduled pre-kickoff: Wed 10am PT — will send calendar invite once PO visible. We'll mark SSO setup as pending in the onboarding tracker.
eva_legal: Once PO is uploaded, I'll route amendment for countersign. We should tag this renewal as 'non-standard: split-entities + start-on-PO' in the tracker.

---

Example PO/invoice mapping shared with customer:
```
Line 1:
- bill_to: Novus Technologies Inc (EIN: 45-6789012)
- scope: US seats + onboarding credits
- invoice_to: Novus APAC Pte Ltd (UEN: 201234567K) // if APAC bank required
Line 2:
- bill_to: Novus EU Reseller (VAT: DE123456789)
- scope: EMEA seats via reseller
Vendor code: NOV-APAC
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required). Please include PO number on invoice.
```

brad_sales: Follow-up scheduled EOD if PO not uploaded. :thumbsup:
